origin.description: Steady state of a 3-D difference scheme.
origin.usage: steady.3D(y, time = 0, func, parms = NULL, nspec = NULL, dimens, method = "stodes", ...)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

origin.details: The default method is the sparse Newton. dimens is stored for the image method.
origin.example: steady.3D(y = rep(0, 8), func = function(t, y, p) list(1 - y), dimens = c(2, 2, 2))

translation.description: Steady state of a 3-D difference scheme.
translation.usage: steady_3d(y, times=None, func=None, parms=None, nspec=None, dimens=None, method="stodes", **kwargs)

arguments.name: y
arguments.text: Initial state. Names are kept when y is a dict.

arguments.name: func
arguments.text: func(time, state, parms) returns a list whose first element is the derivatives.

arguments.name: parms
arguments.text: Passed through to func. NULL when the model has no parameters.

translation.details: The default method is the sparse Newton. dimens is stored for the image method.
translation.example:
from rootSolve import steady_3d

def approach(t, y, p):
    return [[1.0 - value for value in y]]

print(steady_3d([0.0] * 8, func=approach, dimens=(2, 2, 2)))
